race.title: Treble Odds L15s At David Lucas Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: Not the easiest race to get a handle on but last year's winner BEN SOLO has yet to run a bad race here and with his Ffos Las reappearance under his belt, he could be the answer with his yard having made a bright start to the campaign. There are several interesting chase debutants in opposition, though, with Largy Go , Wilstar and Quay Item respected before market clues. Sogna In Grande is another to note. BEN SOLO (IRE) LARGY GO (IRE) WILSTAR (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Wilstar (9/2), Largy Go (6/1), Plains Drifter (6/1), Minella Missile (13/2), Authentic Legacy (7/1), Quay Item (7/1), Ben Solo (8/1), Hardy Du Seuil (12/1), Pepe Le Moko (14/1), Opening Bid (14/1), Sogna In Grande (16/1)
